text:
Leo Grant: Need a compact battlecard + single benchmark slide for launch comms. Primary audience: PLG engineers + SDRs. Goal: scannable in 60s. Can we have a draft by Mon?
Priya Shah: I9ll take competitor voice vs cloud AI platforms. Short bullets: model pinning risk, egress surprises, pricing under burst.
TomE1s Rivera: I9ll own infra vendor angle (ops burden, TCO timeline, upgrade risk). Will include a migration estimate.
Hannah Li: I9ll build the benchmark slide. Prefer p50/p99 for streaming chat + cost/1k tokens. Will use provisional numbers with clear TBD flag.
Leo Grant: Core claim idea: "One inference API, three deployment guarantees: fast, private, and predictable." Need 2 proof bullets per competitor class and one-liner SDR hooks.
Priya Shah: Cloud API bullets: 1) opaque model swaps -> "surprises in behavior"; 2) per-token billing spikes in bursty workloads. SDR hook: "We let you pin model versions and route by policy."
TomE1s Rivera: Infra vendor bullets: 1) hidden ops tax (est. 1.2 FTEs/year); 2) upgrade and kernel compatibility cycles (6mo risk). SDR hook: "We handle runtime tuning and kernel selection for you."
Hannah Li: Draft perf CSV (for slide): ```mode,chat_p50_ms,chat_p99_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens
hosted_api,42,150,$0.92
dedicated_pool,30,85,$0.66
self_hosted,55,310,$0.48``` Footnote: self-hosted variance depends on infra refresh cadence.
Leo Grant: Good. Add a short rebut bank (3 procurement Qs + 1-line answers) so SDRs can field inbound quickly.
Priya Shah: Q1: Data residency? -> "Private control plane, VPC and on-prem options available." Q2: SLA? -> "SLA-backed dedicated tiers with latency SLOs." Q3: Unexpected cost spikes? -> "Dedicated capacity and Redwood Optimize to cap unit economics."
TomE1s Rivera: Migration estimate for mid-market app: 8E2809012 weeks from POC to production (includes validation, rollout, and smoke tests). Add a quick ops-hours calc table.
Hannah Li: I9ll annotate slide with the exact metric definitions (p50/p99 streaming token latency) and call out which runs are synthetic vs customer-collected.
OpsBot: Reminder: webinar registration page needs to be live 2 weeks before event. Legal review deadline locked for 2026-04-05.
Leo Grant: Timeline: draft bullets Mon AM -> Priya/TomE1s; perf mock Mon PM -> Hannah; one-pager + slide Tue for review. Keep everything <1 page.
Priya Shah: Adding cloud competitor soundbites to shared doc: https://tiny.redwood/cloud-soundbites. Please comment.
TomE1s Rivera: Pushed infra rebut snippets to https://tiny.redwood/infra-quick. Included migration checklist and 3 migration-risk flags.
Hannah Li: Uploaded slide mock to drive: https://tiny.redwood/bench-mock. Marked p99 as conservative.
Leo Grant: Final ask: produce 3 SDR-friendly soundbites (<= 12 words) and 1 email opener line. Keep tone crisp and engineer-friendly.
Priya Shah: Soundbites: "Pin your model. Predict your cost."; "No surprise model swaps."; "SLA-backed fast paths." Email opener: "We help engineering teams make inference predictable and cost-effective across deployments."
TomE1s Rivera: Soundbite for infra: "Skip the ops tax. Ship faster."
Hannah Li: Last_message_ts updated to 4456789060 after upload. I'll iterate slide after real perf numbers land.
Leo Grant: Thanks team 12 this will map cleanly into the webinar slide and SDR routing snippets. If procurement gives hard numbers replace placeholders and flag in doc.
Priya Shah: Will ping procurement for real egress and instance pricing.
TomE1s Rivera: I'll run a quick ops-hours sensitivity matrix and drop it into the doc.
Hannah Li: Will finalize slide after numbers. Target final review Wed AM.
